flags.description: Directory holding telltale's trace data (default: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/telltale or the OS cache dir)

flags.name: duration
flags.description: Stop the run after this long, e.g. 30s (0 runs until the command exits or Ctrl+C)

flags.name: every
flags.description: Read the checkpointed captures this often, e.g. 10s

flags.name: follow
flags.description: Print every armed capture's records while recording

flags.name: pid
flags.description: Process to observe

flags.name: seam
flags.description: How the capture is armed (supported seams: [process agent self]) (one of process, agent, self)

flags.name: selector
flags.description: Agent resource attributes to match

flags.name: sort
flags.description: Record order: seq or timestamp

flags.name: tui
flags.description: Follow records in an interactive terminal

flags.name: ui
flags.description: Open this run's traces in a local web viewer; keep serving until Ctrl+C

flags.name: wait
flags.description: Wait for a matching agent to connect
